ja.title: マウント アンド ブレード開発者の共同創設者で「マウント アンド ブレードの母」イペク・ヤヴズ氏が54歳で死去
ja.summary: Mount & Blade の開発者である TaleWorlds Entertainment の共同創設者、イペク ヤヴズ氏が 7 月 22 日に 54 歳で亡くなりました。TaleWorlds はソーシャル メディアの投稿でイペク ヤヴズの初期の貢献を振り返り、彼女の情熱とビジョンがスタジオの基礎を築いたことを強調しました。 TaleWorlds は、2005 年にトゥルキエのアンカラでイペク ヤヴズとアルマアン ヤヴズによって共同設立されました。最初の Mount & Blade の開発段階では、İpek Yavuz がビジュアル デザインに深く関わっていました。もともと小さなチームが徐々に国際的なゲーム スタジオに成長したのは、まさに İpek Yavuz の貢献のおかげです。現在、TaleWorlds は Mount & Blade シリーズで世界的なファンを獲得しています。

en.title: İpek Yavuz, co-founder of Mount and Blade developer and "mother of Mount and Blade", dies at the age of 54
en.summary: İpek Yavuz, co-founder of TaleWorlds Entertainment, the developer of Mount & Blade, passed away on July 22 at the age of 54. TaleWorlds reflected on İpek Yavuz’s early contributions in a social media post, emphasizing that her passion and vision laid the foundation for the studio. TaleWorlds was co-founded by İpek Yavuz and Armağan Yavuz in 2005 in Ankara, Türkiye. During the development phase of the first Mount & Blade, İpek Yavuz was heavily involved in visual design. It is precisely because of İpek Yavuz's contribution that the original small team gradually grew into an international game studio. Today, TaleWorlds has amassed a global following with the Mount & Blade series.

Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it.
